finding.problem: _child_env() copies the complete parent environment and only blanks GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, STEGVERSE_GITHUB_TOKEN, and TVC_TOKEN. Arbitrary unrelated secret/token variables therefore remain eligible to reach the carrier and WorkerCoordinator child processes while the emitted receipt unconditionally claims non_tv_tvc_secret_or_token_used=false.
finding.why_existing_test_is_insufficient: The current test proves only that the four named FORBIDDEN_ENV variables are blank. It does not inject and reject an arbitrary non-TV/TVC secret such as OPENAI_API_KEY, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, provider credentials, or another unknown *_TOKEN/*_SECRET variable.
finding.required_correction: Construct child process environments from an explicit non-secret allowlist plus StegVerse runtime-control variables, rather than copying os.environ. Preserve TV/TVC as credential authority but do not forward a TVC credential unless a separately admitted task capability explicitly requires it; this runtime path currently declares credential_requirement NONE.
finding.required_regression: Inject representative unrelated secret/token variables and assert they are absent from both spawned child environments; continue asserting StegVerse runtime root/node markers and required non-secret process variables are present.
finding.release_rule: Do not claim the no-NON-TV/TVC-secret runtime predicate from this supervisor until the corrected environment boundary and regression test are directly validated.

next_executable_action: Canonical task-capable release-hardening claimant corrects the child-environment boundary and adds the regression test, then validates the exact current head before proceeding to live WorkerCoordinator execution and G18 terminalization.
